component.title: Agent avatar
component.purpose: Identifies an agent at a glance from the colour triple its prompt-manager descriptor already carries, so a roster is scannable without reading names.

states.description: The agent's colour triple rendered at roster size.
The descriptor has not resolved yet.
The descriptor could not be read; the avatar says so rather than showing a blank.
Inline size, used beside a message author name.
Several agents in one room, overlapped.

claims.statement: The avatar renders from the descriptor's body, head and accent values rather than from a generated hash.
claims.rationale: The triple already exists on every agent descriptor; deriving a different identity would make the roster and the descriptor disagree.

claims.statement: The avatar carries the agent's display name as its accessible name, never just the word avatar.
An unreadable descriptor is perceivably distinct from a still-loading one.
The colour triple keeps sufficient contrast against both theme grounds.

priorities.statement: Which agent this is, before any text is read
Whether the profile failed to resolve
